name: Hakumei
source: Apart from being an alchemy prodigy, Hakumei is the headmaster of the academy. Partner to the sky beast, Ziz , Hakumei fights to free the earth from worldly evils. Though she holds the position of prestige, Hakumei`s personality is true to her girlish appearance. She is easily flustered and quick to anger.
